scope: Continuous original radius-two four-link loop formulas with explicitly constructed V=E+kappa Delta(psi)/psi, complete sixteen central signs and retained probability mass. Marginal resolvent identity uses a specified f with its computed source. Original a_j,s_j retained in those diagnostics; no Wilson vacuum or its resolvent is sampled. Finite matrix diagnostics retain noncommuting products and every covariance component.
